Hypothesis: The bug is in `src/cachetools/__init__.py`, `TTLCache.expire()`.

Expiration checks are inconsistent at the TTL boundary:

- `__contains__`, `__getitem__`, and iteration treat an item as expired when `time >= expires` via `time < expires`.
- `expire()` currently removes items only when `time > curr.expires`, leaving items whose expiration timestamp equals the current time in the cache’s size bookkeeping.

I intend to change the `expire()` loop condition from `time > curr.expires` to an equivalent inclusive-boundary check, `not (time < curr.expires)`, so cleanup occurs at exactly the same timestamp used by membership and iteration.
